Update the logic around hasExpect so failed tool calls with invalid expectations cannot bypass the failure branch. - Line 212: Update the play flow around hasExpect and ipcCall so IPC connection and timeout failures are handled as errors before evaluating the expected tool result. Review comments at @src/core/Document.cpp: - Around line 1447-1448: Update the words branch in statCount to count only blocks accepted by blockVisibleForStat, matching the visibility behavior of the other statistics. Iterate through doc.body, skip hidden blocks, count each visible block’s non-empty whitespace-separated words, and return the accumulated total instead of doc.wordCount(). Update rememberConditionals to store each field run’s exported visible text and a plain-text identity for blocks with hide_if, then update applyFieldConditionals to search for matching eligible runs and apply hide_if only when the block identity matches; skip entries without a match. Adjust the relevant function signatures and callers, including the Document context needed to compute displayed run text. - Around line 362-373: Restrict native IF generation in nativeWordField to operands accepted by a new wordIfOperandSafe helper: allow numeric values or operands enclosed in double quotes only. When either operand is unsafe, return false so the evaluated-text fallback preserves the field metadata; apply the same safety check in the fallback decision path alongside singleComparison. Review comments at @src/core/FieldExpr.cpp: - Around line 232-274: Add a bounded recursion counter to the expression parser, initialized alongside error_ with a fixed maximum such as 256. In parseUnary, increment and validate depth_ before recursive parsing, then decrement after it returns; apply the same guarded increment/decrement around parseOr in parsePrimary for parenthesized expressions. On exceeding the limit, call fail() and return an empty value so the parser reports an invalid expression without overflowing the stack. Review comments at @src/core/FieldExpr.h: - Line 9: Change the forward declaration of Document in FieldExpr.h from class to struct so it matches the struct Document definition and keeps function symbols consistent across translation units. Review comments at @src/core/Session.cpp: - Line 2556: Update the argument handling around the existing seq and input_list branches to preserve JSON-object values: read args["arg"] once, serialize it compactly when it is an object, otherwise retain its string conversion, and reuse that normalized result for fieldArg instead of converting args["arg"] again. Keep the existing if-branch behavior unchanged. It does this for words, chars, paragraphs, tables, and images. `documentStats` applies `blockHiddenByExpr` only to the paragraph branch. A page-dependent `hide_if`, such as `page > 1`, is therefore evaluated against the wrong page. > > As a result, `document_stats` and a `stat` field can show different numbers for the same document. Use the visibility rule from `statCount` for every counter. > >
> 🐛 Proposed fix > > ```diff > for (const auto &b : doc_.body) { > - if (b.type == QLatin1String("paragraph") && !blockHiddenByExpr(doc_, b, 1, 1)) > + const bool hidden = blockHiddenByExpr(doc_, b, lay.displayPage(lay.pageOf(b.id)), qMax(1, lay.pages)); > + if (hidden) > + continue; > + if (b.type == QLatin1String("paragraph")) > ++paras; > ``` > > To make `words` match the `stat` field, compute it in the same loop over visible blocks instead of calling `doc_.wordCount()`. >
